title: Trump orders military to ‘substantially reduce’ joint exercises with South Korea
script: A new headline is now getting attention across the news cycle. The main headline is this: Trump orders military to ‘substantially reduce’ joint exercises with South Korea. In simple words, The president said he has directed the Pentagon to scale down the exercises, citing South Korea’s refusal to join the war in Iran and his “very good” relationship with North Korea’s Kim Jong Un Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update.
